docs.summary: Provides reflection information for variables defined in a shader source module. This struct acts as a managed wrapper around the native Slang variable reflection API.
Gets the name of the variable.
Gets the type information for this variable.
Gets the number of user attributes attached to this variable.
Gets a user attribute by its index.
docs.returns: The attribute at the specified index.

params.index: The zero-based index of the attribute to retrieve.

docs.summary: Gets all user attributes attached to this variable.
Finds an attribute by its name.
docs.returns: The attribute with the specified name if found.

params.name: The name of the attribute to find.

docs.summary: Finds a user attribute by its name. This is an alias for [`FindAttributeByName`](#api~Prowl.Slang.VariableReflection~FindAttributeByName).
docs.returns: The attribute with the specified name if found.

params.name: The name of the attribute to find.

docs.summary: Gets a value indicating whether this variable has a default value.
Gets the default value of this variable as an integer.
docs.returns: The default integer value of this variable.

docs.summary: Gets the generic container for this variable, if it is part of a generic context.
Applies specializations from a generic reflection object to this variable.
docs.returns: A new variable reflection with the applied specializations.

params.generic: The generic reflection containing specializations to apply.

docs.summary: Indicates whether this variable has a specific modifier.
